## Description

Proposed robust approach to volatility-surface forecasting: Forecast the implied-volatility surface across option strikes and expirations, then use those forecasts to inform option valuation, risk limits, or hedging. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
